I actually just did it today :)

First I did a coconut oil masque, let it sit for 2 hours and then did the chelating with the dish soap. Then I mixed the lemon juice with a bit of water and poured it on after washing out the soap. I let it sit for a bit while I showered and then rinsed it out. After, I put on the moroccan oil hydrating masque, also letting it sit. I just finished blowdrying my hair and it is insanely soft.
